methods_quotes.q: Nirsevimab effectiveness against medically attended ARI associated with RSV infection was evaluated using a test-negative design.
Odds ratios and 95% CIs were estimated using multivariable logistic regression analysis comparing receipt of nirsevimab among case- and control patients.
Regression models were adjusted for age in months at medical visit, sex, calendar month, residence community type
Effectiveness was calculated as (1 − adjusted odds ratio) × 100%.
